thread:
maria (sec-eng): Heads up — pen test kickoff next Wed. Need to lock scope, RBAC changes, KMS access, and retest windows. Can we sync asap?
alex (eng-sre): Yep. Do we have a proposed scope doc? Link?
maría (sec-eng): https://redwood-internal/pt/sprint-2026Q1 — rough scope in the top section. Key asks: temporary KMS grants for assessors, CloudTrail exports, and a 48h evidence window after tests.
sam (infra): For KMS: prefer a KMS proxy role with limited Decrypt/Describe for the readroom. Avoid giving raw CMK access. We can mint ephemeral creds for the proxy (1hr TTL).
jamie (ops): +1 on proxy. Also need to confirm audit log retention — we'll snapshot daily and upload to pre-signed S3 readroom. How long does the assessor need access?
claire (legal): From compliance POV, evidence retention should be 90 days after handoff. Anything longer needs approvals. PII must be redacted before handoff.
maria (sec-eng): Good call. Operational asks: 1) RBAC change PR + reviewer, 2) KMS proxy runbook, 3) S3 readroom pre-signed flow. Who volunteers to draft each?
alex (eng-sre): I can open the RBAC PR (will use scoped IAM policy). Will tag sam for KMS bits.
sam (infra): I'll draft the KMS proxy runbook. Proposed policy snippet:```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Action":["kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],
    "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pt-proxy-key"
  }]
}
```
(We restrict via condition on aws:RequestTag/pt-session).
jamie (ops): For S3 readroom, we'll generate presigned URLs and rotate them every 24h. Example to upload logs:```bash
aws s3 cp cloudtrail-2026-03-23.json s3://redwood-pt-readroom/ --acl private
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-readroom/cloudtrail-2026-03-23.json --expires-in 86400
```
maria (sec-eng): Perfect. For retest slots: propose two windows — Apr 6 09:00-13:00 PT and Apr 9 13:00-17:00 PT. Canary dry-run the day before (Apr 5) limited to staging only. Thoughts?
alex (eng-sre): Those look good. I'll block on-call for Apr 6 & 9. Please add the dry-run in calendar invites.
claire (legal): We need an NDA signed for the contractor assessors before any readroom access. Confirmed?
maria (sec-eng): Yes, will confirm with vendor. Jamie, can you own verifying NDAs before creds are minted?
jamie (ops): On it. Will label the ticket SSO:NDA-check and set a precondition in the runbook.
sam (infra): One more tech question — will we allow KMS Encrypt/Decrypt in staging for reproduction? If so, use separate CMK with different key policy.
maria (sec-eng): Prefer separated CMKs. Add to runbook. Also: during test please stream key usage logs to our SIEM and tag test sessions with pt:id so we can filter.
alex (eng-sre): I'll add pt:id tagging in the proxy wrapper. Also adding CloudTrail event filter in SIEM: pt:id=*
maria (sec-eng): Nice. Next steps: alex opens RBAC PR by EOD, sam posts KMS runbook draft by tomorrow noon, jamie sets NDA checklist and presigned flow, I'll finalize scope doc and confirm vendor NDA. If anything blocks, ping this thread. :thumbsup:
pt-bot: New ticket PT-4521 created: pen-test coordination — RBAC/KMS/readroom. Assigned to alex, sam, jamie.
alex (eng-sre): Got it. I'll link PR to PT-4521.
jamie (ops): Scheduling invites now. Dry-run calendar invite sent to #eng-oncall and vendor contact.
maría (sec-eng): Thanks all — we should do a 15m sync tomorrow after runbook draft. Short and tactical.
